verdict.rationale: Rainforest's docs state that platforms keep full ownership of all payment and merchant data and may export it at any time. However, this is a single claim on an unrelated JavaScript-bundle page, with no detail on how export works or in which formats. An OpenAPI 3.1.0-specified API and webhooks suggest data could be pulled out programmatically, but no bulk export is documented. Missing for 10: a documented bulk export mechanism, a specification of open export formats (e.g. CSV/JSON), offboarding/account-closure guidance, and independent or hands-on corroboration that a full export works.
